FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: WealthGuard Financial Advisors provides comprehensive financial planning and investment management services tailored to meet the unique needs of individuals, families, and small businesses. Our core operations include asset allocation, retirement planning, tax-efficient investment strategies, and risk management. We are committed to maintaining a high standard of compliance with SEC and FINRA regulations, ensuring a secure and ethical approach to client assets. Our team consists of certified financial planners and investment analysts who engage in ongoing professional education to stay abreast of market trends and regulatory updates. We employ industry-standard cybersecurity measures to protect sensitive client data and conduct regular internal audits to foster transparency and operational excellence. Furthermore, our client onboarding processes are standardized to mitigate risks and ensure the integrity of our service delivery.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: WealthGuard Investments, LLC - a subsidiary focused on private equity and venture capital investments, engaging in strategic financial partnerships.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2021, we experienced a data breach incident that exposed client personal information due to a phishing attack. The total estimated cost associated with remediation and client notifications was $15,000. This incident has since been fully resolved, and we have since enhanced our cybersecurity measures by implementing multi-factor authentication and conducting comprehensive staff training.
